fields.title: 📖 Holding the Soul to Account
fields.body:
🖋️ **Al-Ḥasan al-Baṣrī** رحمه الله said, in a paraphrase of the reported meaning:

“The believer **keeps watch over himself** and *holds himself accountable for the sake of Allāh*.

The reckoning on the Day of Resurrection will be **easier** for those who *held themselves accountable in this world*.

But the reckoning will be **harder** for those who went about their affairs *without examining themselves*.”

🌙 **Conclusion:** **Nurturing one's own soul begins with sincere self-examination.** Whoever *recognizes their mistakes*, restrains their desires and holds themselves to account strives for **purification of the soul** and obedience to Allāh.
